verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page lists "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA" as an online capability, and EFILE filers can view their transmission history. Both require signing in to an account (CRA account or EFILE credentials) rather than using openly accessible public pages, and the tracking claim is a single line. missing for 10: status lookup on public, unauthenticated pages, documentation of what filings, applications or cases can be tracked (e.g. BN registration status), detail on the status information shown, independent or hands-on corroboration.
